text.ms:
1.  Kapasiti tempat
duduk

Tidak melebihi enam puluh tujuh
orang termasuk pemandu, dengan
dua lajur  tempat duduk yang
mempunyai tempat duduk
berkembar

Tidak melebihi enam puluh tujuh
orang termasuk pemandu , dengan
sekurang-kurangnya satu lajur
tempat duduk yang mempunyai
satu tempat duduk tunggal

2.  Tanda pengenalan Perkataan "EKSPRES EKONOMI/
ECONOMY EXPRESS" hendaklah
dipamerkan pada bahagian luar
dan dalam pintu masuk bas
ekspres mengikut cara yang
berikut:

(a) Jenis tulisan: Impact

(b) Saiz tulisan: 30 cm x 4 cm

(c) Warna tulisan: Putih

Perkataan "EKSPRES EKSEKUTIF/
EXECUTIVE EXPRESS" hendaklah
dipamerkan pada bahagian luar
dan dalam pintu masuk bas
ekspres mengikut cara yang
berikut:

(a) Jenis tulisan: Impact

(b)  Saiz tulisan: 30 cm x 4 cm

(c)  Warna tulisan: Putih

3.  Panjang kenderaan Tidak kurang daripada 10.5 meter dan tidak lebih daripada panjang
maksimum bagi suatu bas  sebagaimana yang ditetapkan dalam
Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan Motor (Pembinaan dan Penggunaan) 1959
[L.N. 170/1959]

".

Peralihan

4. Pada tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa Peraturan-Peraturan ini, mana-mana pengendali
berlesen yang mengendalikan atau mengadakan apa-apa perkhidmatan
bas ekspres hendaklah, dalam tempoh enam bulan dari tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa
Peraturan-Peraturan ini, mematuhi spesifikasi perkhidmatan bas ekspres mengikut
Peraturan-Peraturan ibu sebagaimana yang dipinda oleh Peraturan-Peraturan ini.

Dibuat 11 Jun 2026
[MOT.PUU.600-1/15/2 JLD. 11(S) (16); PN(PU2)692/IV]

                      LOKE SIEW FOOK
                             Menteri Pengangkutan

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT ACT 2010

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT (PRESCRIPTION OF CATEGORY OF EXPRESS BUS SERVICES)
(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 252(1) (tr) and (u) and
subsection 252(2) of the Land Public Transport Act 2010 [ Act 715 ],
the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Land Public Transport
(Prescription of Category of Express Bus Services) (Amendment) Regulations 2026.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 15 June 2026.

Amendment of enacting clause
2. The Land Public Transport (Prescription of Category of Express Bus Services)
Regulations 2022 [P.U. (A) 206/2022], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations"
in these Regulations , are amended in the enacting clause by substituting for the words
"and (u)" the words ", (tac) and (u)".

Amendment of Schedule
3. The principal Regulations  are amended by substituting for the Schedule
the following schedule:

"SCHEDULE
[Subregulation 2(2)]
SPECIFICATION OF EXPRESS BUS SERVICES
(1)
Item
(2)
Description
(3)
Specification

Economy express bus Executive express bus

1.  Seating capacity  Not exceeding sixty -seven
persons inclusive of the driver ,
with two seating columns
comprising of double seating
Not exceeding sixty-seven persons
inclusive of the driver , with at
least one seating column
comprising of one single seating

2.  Identification mark The word " EKSPRES EKONOMI /
ECONOMY EXPRESS" shall be
displayed on the outside and
inside of the entrance door of
express bus in the following
manner:

(a) Font type: Impact

(b) Font size: 30 cm x 4 cm

(c) Font color: White

The word "EKSPRES EKSEKUTIF/
EXECUTIVE EXPRESS" shall be
displayed on the outside and
inside of the entrance door of
express bus in the following
manner:

(a)  Font type: Impact

(b)  Font size: 30 cm x 4 cm

(c)  Font color: White

3.  Length of vehicle  Not less than 10.5 metres and not more than the maximum length for
a bus as prescribed in the Motor Vehicles (Construction and Use)
Rules 1959 [L.N. 170/1959]

".

Transitional
4. On the date of coming into operation of these Regulations, a ny licensed operator
who operates or provides any express bus service shall, within the period of six months
from the date of coming into operation of these Regulation s, comply with
the specification of express bus services in accordance with  the principal Regulations as
amended by these Regulations.

Made 11 June 2026
[MOT.BD.(S).600-2/21/1 JLD6(41); PN(PU2)692/IV]

                              LOKE SIEW FOOK
                                  Minister of Transport
